data.one_liner: Video caching and local proxy server for Flutter video playback
data.what_it_does: It sets up a local HTTP proxy server to cache, pre-cache, and stream video content simultaneously. It supports formats like MP4 and HLS (m3u8), offering LRU-based memory and file caching.
use_when: You need to cache remote videos locally while playing them with the video_player package.
You want to pre-cache video segments ahead of time for smoother playback.
You handle HLS (m3u8) or MP4 streams that require custom headers or token-ignoring cache keys.
avoid_when: Your app does not use video playback or streaming.
You prefer an entirely native audio/video player framework that manages its own caching without a local HTTP proxy.
strengths: Supports multiple video formats including MP4 and HLS (m3u8).
Provides pre-caching and simultaneous playback and caching.
Configurable memory/storage cache limits and custom HTTP clients via Dio.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration to permit cleartext local HTTP traffic for the proxy server.
Running a local HTTP server proxy introduces background lifecycle management considerations.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing the video proxy server on startup and configuring Android network security config and iOS Info.plist for local cleartext traffic.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you do not need caching functionality and just want the standard Flutter team video player.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are focusing heavily on advanced audio playback features.
